key_patterns: SQLite migrations: versioned via PRAGMA user_version in src-tauri/src/db/mod.rs — appliquer_migrations_versionnees() checks version < N and calls migration_vN(). Cannot ALTER TABLE to change CHECK constraints in SQLite; must rename→recreate→copy→drop. TYPES_FRET const in tarification.rs is the single Rust source of truth for valid type_fret values, consumed by verifier_valeurs() in tarif.rs and normaliser_type_fret() in bordereau.rs. TypeFret union in src/types/index.ts is the TS source of truth. TYPES_FRET array in src/utils/index.ts powers all <Select> dropdowns. Zod schemas in page files contain hardcoded z.enum([...]) that must also be updated.
